subject: english
question:
**Identify the part of the sentence that contains a grammatical error.**

"A. He is B. not only intelligent C. and hardworking, D. but also very kind."
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence uses the correlative conjunction "**not only... but also**," which is used to connect two balanced clauses or phrases.
 
• The inclusion of "**and**" in part C is redundant and grammatically incorrect because the "not only" in part B is already waiting to be paired with "but also" in part D.
 
• To maintain the correct correlative structure, the conjunction "and" should be removed or replaced to ensure the two parts of the pair correlate directly.
 
• Thus, the error is located in **part C** (Option 3) of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"He is **not only intelligent hardworking, but also** very kind." *

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Correlative Conjunctions:** These are pairs like *either... or*, *neither... nor*, and *not only... but also*. They must connect grammatically similar elements (parallelism).
 
• **A: "He is"** – This is the subject and helping verb, which is correct.
 
• **B: "not only intelligent"** – This starts the correlative pair correctly.
 
• **D: "but also very kind"** – This completes the correlative pair correctly.
 
• **Parallelism:** When using "not only... but also," ensure that the words following each part of the conjunction are the same part of speech (in this case, adjectives: intelligent/hardworking and kind).
